mapper.select: SELECT xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as reportedIssue, fault.faultCode AS faultCodes, mc.CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION as customerOrganization FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS xm LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo USING (MO_OID) LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER mc USING (MC_OID) LEFT JOIN (SELECT xfc.xm_OID, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fault.VALUE) AS faultCode FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_FAULT_CODE xfc JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_FAULT_CODE_VALUES fault ON fault.SFV_OID = xfc.FAULT_CODE GROUP BY xfc.xm_OID) fault USING (xm_OID) WHERE XM_OID = #{id}
